description: This file defines classes for streaming iterators used in Google GenAI content generation API, including synchronous and asynchronous versions, with logging and response handling logic.

classes.name: BaseGoogleGenAIGenerateContentStreamingIterator
classes.description: Base class providing common logic for streaming response handling and logging for Google GenAI content generation.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIGenerateContentStreamingIterator
classes.description: Synchronous streaming iterator for Google GenAI generate content API responses.

classes.name: AsyncGoogleGenAIGenerateContentStreamingIterator
classes.description: Asynchronous streaming iterator for Google GenAI generate content API responses.

methods.name: _handle_async_streaming_logging
methods.description: Handles logging after all chunks are collected asynchronously.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with response, model, logging, and config.

methods.name: __next__
methods.description: Returns the next chunk in the synchronous iterator.

methods.name: __aiter__
methods.description: Returns the async iterator object itself.

methods.name: __anext__
methods.description: Returns the next chunk asynchronously; triggers logging on completion.
